children: ApeCoin and Alchemy will host a community co-working meetup in New York City on October 13th for teams building on ApeChain and attendees arriving ahead of ApeFest.
On the way to ApeFest next week?
Come build with us in NYC.
on October 13 to meet the community and teams building ON APECHAIN.
Drop in to co-work w/ the ApeChain & Alchemy teams, alongside other Apes arriving early.

ApeCoin (APE) is an ERC-20 governance and utility token underpinning the APE ecosystem, a decentralized protocol layer propelling community building in Web 3.0. Yuga Labs, creators of the prominent Bored Ape Yacht Club (BAYC) NFT collections and rights holders to CryptoPunks and Meebits, has integrated APE as the chief token for its new products and services.

The ApeCoin DAO, a decentralized autonomous organization, facilitates APE token holders in executing governance decisions, from fund allocations to establishing partnerships. Upon DAO members' voting, the APE Foundation, the DAO’s legal caretaker, actualizes these governance decisions.

Serving as the participatory key to the ApeCoin DAO, the APE token enables access to unique APE ecosystem features such as exclusive games, merchandise, and events. Moreover, third-party developers can integrate the APE token into their platforms as incentives.

title: ApeCoin to Host Meetup in NYC on October 13th
